name: Thailand
description: Thailand from Ban Chiang and Sukhothai to Ayutthaya, the Chakri kings, a land never colonised, coups and a modern kingdom.

checkpoints.name: Early kingdoms
checkpoints.note: Bronze Age villages flourished at Ban Chiang. Mon and Khmer kingdoms ruled before the Thai kingdom of Sukhothai rose in the 1200s.

checkpoints.name: Ayutthaya
checkpoints.note: Ayutthaya grew into one of the great trading cities of Asia, until the Burmese destroyed it in 1767.

checkpoints.name: Bangkok and Siam
checkpoints.note: The Chakri kings built Bangkok. Chulalongkorn reformed the state and kept Siam free while its neighbours became colonies.

checkpoints.name: Modern Thailand
checkpoints.note: A coup in 1932 ended absolute monarchy. Generals and elected leaders took turns in power, Bhumibol reigned for seventy years, and Bangkok became a great city of Asia.
